messages.subject: GGIR training opportunities in 2023
parts:
Dear all, 

We are delighted to announce that we have updated our GGIR training program for 2023! 

GGIR standard training

The standard training in GGIR has been updated and re-organized in a 3 x 2 hours training conducted in one week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday). The standard training focuses on common use-cases of GGIR, providing a wide picture of the functionalities  and the theory behind the main algorithms included in GGIR. The GGIR standard training will also propose you some hands-on activities that will allow you to get familiarized with the processing pipeline and will improve your user experience with GGIR.

Next training opportunities in May and November 2023!

R essentials for GGIR

This year we have decided to extend out training options with this introductory course to the R essentials that you will need to master when working with GGIR. If you have no prior (or limited) experience with R, this training will provide you with the R skills needed to successfully run GGIR. This is the perfect complement to the GGIR standard training, and it is always conducted the week before the stardard training.

Next training opportunities in May and November 2023!

GGIR private training

The private training is our most flexible approach to train you in GGIR. If you need specific help for using GGIR in your research project(s), the private training will give us the flexibility needed to focus on the topics that are of your interest.

Extra GGIR support session

Are you already familiar with GGIR but you need some extra help? We now offer single 90-minute sessions to help you out with your use of GGIR and the challenges you may run into.

For a detailed description and options to book your seat go to our dedicated webpage: https://www.accelting.com/ggir-training/ 

Do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions via trai...@accelting.com.

Kind regards, 

Vincent and Jairo
